snippet.title: System Design Shopify eCommerce platform Interview Question for software engineers
snippet.description:
How do you design an eCommerce platform like Shopify? In this episode we are going to explore multiple options and we will be using Docker containers, Packer VM's and AWS cloud resources like EC2 and RDS to build our own Shopify system design and answer a hypothetical "How do you design Shopify?" interview question. We will also cover a monitoring system with health checks.

DISCLAIMER: I'm not affiliated with Shopify, I don't know how their internal architecture looks like and while we will cover a lot of topics in this video, we can barely scratch the surface of this system design.

09:25 Key features
11:56 Designing for Isolation
20:23 Advantages and Disadvantages of design
25:00 Hosting and networking, end to end examples

snippet.title: System Design Interview - Design Yelp Geospatial Geohash
snippet.description:
How to design a system like Yelp? In this video we explore some approaches to design a service or app with features that resemble Yelp and similar products: Recommendations based on geographical proximity, rating systems, comments, likes and points of interest.
We will talk about geospatial databases, geohashing, R-trees and more.

@4:00 - Core features of Yelp
@15:15 - Geohashing explanation
@21:52 Optimizations like sharding of database

This is a popular system design interview question you could face in software engineering interviews at companies like Google, Facebook, Uber, Yelp, Snapchat, Twitter...

DISCLAIMER: I'm not affiliated with Yelp and I'm not an expert when it comes to geospatial databases, geohashing etc. 

Check out the two videos below for more in-depth information

snippet.title: How load balancers work - System Design Interview knowledge [Beyond the interview]
snippet.description:
Knowing about how a load balancer works is important for most software engineers. Load balancing algorithms and techniques can be useful for your next system design interview too. Besides that, it quite interesting!

This video covers load balancing algorithms, how Google uses load balancing and traffic routing, a real word load balancing example for a web application, stateful load balancing and consistent hashing for load balancing.

Google book about site reliability engineering: https://landing.google.com/sre/book.html

Consistent hashing paper: https://www.akamai.com/es/es/multimedia/documents/technical-publication/consistent-hashing-and-random-trees-distributed-caching-protocols-for-relieving-hot-spots-on-the-world-wide-web-technical-publication.pdf
